title: Scooter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wheelGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfd8e3'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#7f8fa6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a5568'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='42' ry='4' fill='#22304a'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='80' r='11' fill='url(#wheelGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='80' r='4.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='80' r='11' fill='url(#wheelGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='80' r='4.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='22' y='66' width='54' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='22' y='66' width='54' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9a8b'/>
  <!-- deck grip stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='67.5' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='38' y='67.5' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='46' y='67.5' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='54' y='67.5' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='62' y='67.5' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- steering column -->
  <rect x='70' y='34' width='7' height='34' rx='3' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <rect x='70' y='34' width='3' height='34' rx='1.5' fill='#8ef0e8'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='60' y='32' width='26' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- handlebar grips -->
  <rect x='58' y='31' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='81' y='31' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='73.5' cy='44' r='5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='73.5' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- face plate on deck front (mascot face on the scooter) -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='13' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='54' r='2.6' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='54' r='2.6' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <circle cx='35.9' cy='53.1' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45.9' cy='53.1' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M33 60 Q40 66 47 60' stroke='#2b3a55' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='59' r='2.2' fill='#ff9a8b'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='59' r='2.2' fill='#ff9a8b'/>
</svg>
